title: myrtus belgica
intro: Myrtus belgica, commonly known as Kanuka, is a plant species native to Australia and New Zealand. It is a small tree or shrub with aromatic leaves and resinous wood, traditionally used for its medicinal and therapeutic properties. The health benefits of Kanuka oil include its antimicrobial, antifungal, and anti-inflammatory properties, which can aid in wound healing, skin conditions, and respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of Kanuka oil include sesquiterpenes, such as alpha-pinene, beta-pinene, and alpha-terpineol, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant effects.
